description.value:
While you are also a living creature, you are a level 0 or 1 simple, martial, or advanced weapon, either a common weapon or another weapon to which you have access.

You can be upgraded using most runes (or monster parts from Battlezoo Bestiary) as normal for a weapon of your kind, and you can be affected by spells and abilities that provide similar benefits, such as magic weapon. However, runes or other item upgrades and abilities that depend upon being an object or assume you aren't a creature or are otherwise based on different assumptions (such as runes that set or increase Hardness or object Hit Points, or a hypothetical rune that makes a weapon invincible to all damage in a manner similar to an indestructible shield) don't work. Your GM determines which runes and effects can't apply. Typically, anything that simply makes a weapon better at fighting when you wield it normally works fine. On the other hand, anything that makes a weapon more resilient, harder to destroy, or harder to lose, or that teleports the object around or grants the object mobility (like the dancing rune) are never allowed. The GM might determine it's appropriate to allow you to upgrade yourself into a specific weapon using the above criteria. If your class grants you a special weapon (such as weapon inventor) or is connected to a weapon (such as weapon implement thaumaturge), you can choose yourself for that weapon as long as you meet any other requirements or restrictions imposed by your class.

Whether you were forged with arcane power, were grown with verdant primal energy, were whispered with occult secrets, or were imbued with blessings as a divine weapon, a certain sort of magic was important during your creation. Choose a single magical tradition used in your creation, which is called your “weapon magical tradition.” This is your magical tradition for intelligent weapon feats with the magical trait or that depend on a magical tradition, as well as for monster part imbued properties depending on a magical tradition.
